```{r load-data}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(mirt)
library(rlang)
library(multidplyr)
library(levantemodels)

regdir <- here("02_scoring_outputs", "model_registry")

# tasks to include in these analyses
irt_tasks <- c("pa",
               "swr",
               "math",
               "matrix",
               "mrot",
               "sds",
               "tom",
               "hf",
               "mg",
               "trog",
               "vocab")

task_data_irt <- read_rds(here("01_fetched_data/task_data_nested.rds")) |>
  filter(item_task %in% irt_tasks)
```

```{r}
# define set of multigroup models (Rasch/2PL x invariance)
models_multigroup <- tribble(
  ~nfact, ~itemtype, ~invariance,
       1,   "Rasch", "configural",
       1,   "Rasch", "scalar",
       1,     "2PL", "configural",
       1,     "2PL", "metric",
       1,     "2PL", "scalar",
)

# define set of pooled models (Rasch/2PL)
models_pooled <- tribble(
  ~nfact, ~itemtype,
       1,   "Rasch",
       1,   "2PL"
)

# define priors (list where names are parameter names and values are vectors with priorType, val1, val2)
priors <- list(d = c("norm", 0, 3), a1 = c("norm", 1, 0.3))
```

```{r}
# list currently defined objects
objs <- ls()

# set up cluster for parallelization
cluster <- new_cluster(length(irt_tasks)) |>
  cluster_library(c("tidyverse", "mirt", "glue", "rlang", "levantemodels")) |>
  cluster_copy(objs)

# fit by-language pooled models for each task (in parallel)
cluster |>
  cluster_assign_each(task = irt_tasks) |>
  cluster_send(fit_bylanguage_task(task_data = task_data_irt,
                                   models = models_pooled,
                                   priors = priors,
                                   task = task,
                                   registry_dir = regdir))

# fit multigroup models for each task (in parallel)
cluster |>
  cluster_assign_each(task = irt_tasks) |>
  cluster_send(fit_task_models_multigroup(task_data = task_data_irt,
                                          models = models_multigroup,
                                          priors = priors,
                                          task = task,
                                          # group = site,
                                          group = dataset,
                                          registry_dir = regdir))
```

```{r}
fit_bylanguage_task(task_data = task_data_irt,
                    models = models_pooled,
                    priors = priors,
                    task = "pa",
                    registry_dir = regdir)
```
